title: KPop 6 Demon Hunters Mystery Blind Box Anime Action Figure Doll Rumi Mira Zoey
descriptionText: The product is a KPop Demon Hunters Mystery Blind Box featuring action figure dolls of characters like Rumi, Mira, and Zoey. Each doll is part of the anime and manga theme and comes in a boxed packaging. This blind box offers collectors the chance to receive different characters from the KPop Demon Hunters franchise, adding an element of surprise and excitement to the purchase. Perfect for fans of the series and collectors of anime and manga merchandise.
